command: from pathlib import Path; import json,sys; t=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"); fragments=[x.strip() for x in Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig").splitlines() if x.strip()]; missing=[f for f in fragments if f not in t]; declarations=sum(line.startswith("declare ") and "@GetEnvironmentVariableW(" in line for line in t.splitlines()); passed=not missing and declarations==1 and "@_wgetenv" not in t; print(json.dumps({"missingOriginalFragments":missing,"GetEnvironmentVariableWDeclarations":declarations,"wgetenvAbsent":"@_wgetenv" not in t,"passed":passed}));sys.exit(0 if passed else 1)
